Wake up. The goddess didn't send you here to die.
source_en.좋아, 감각이 있군. 계속 쳐!: Good, you've got instinct. Keep swinging!

You're invincible while the chain pulls you. Use it when things get rough.
Press Q! Create a shield with malice.

Can't parry? Just hit them. Not dying is enough.
There you go! You're getting the hang of it.
That's the ghost crossbow. Say hello.
You opened a treasure chest. Boss-tier gear pours out.
source_en.상자 대박! 좋은 거 잔뜩 나와! 보이면 꼭 열어!: Chest jackpot! Tons of good stuff! Always open them!
Break the debris open too. Malice and gear hide inside.
source_en.잔해에서 악의가 나온다! 보이면 다 주워!: Debris drops malice! Grab every one you see!
Don't fear white bullets. Malice is strong.
Don't fear red bullets. Malice is strong.
source_en.패링으로 돌려주고, Q 보호막도 써! 악의를 잘 굴려!: Parry them back, use Q shield too! Master your malice!
Rainbow shots take a Q parry. E won't work.
Colored shots take a Q parry. E won't work.
…You're burning. Burns only get worse. Restore your HP.

You're bleeding out. Shift. Get out.
E. Strike when their wrist bends.
Red bullets are chunks of malice. Deflect and use them.
Parry rainbow shots with Q too! E will not work.

source_en.스킬포인트가 쌓였어! K 눌러서 스킬 배우자!: Skill points ready! Press K to learn skills!
Read the elements. Hit weaknesses for double damage.
source_en.K를 눌러봐! 스킬을 배울 수 있어!: Press K! You can learn skills!
source_en.J 눌러서 능력치 찍어! 패시브도 있어~: Press J for stats! Passives too~
Press G. Upgrade gear at the forge.
source_en.F키는 영역 스킬 전용이야! L로 배정해봐~: F is for area skills only! Press L to assign one~
Z. That's your ultimate. Use it wisely.
source_en.L-CTRL로 유령걸음이나 얼음보주 쓸 수 있어!: L-CTRL for Ghost Walk or Ice Orb!
Press L. Organize your skill slots.
source_en.가방 터지겠다! N 눌러서 창고에 넣어둬!: Bag's about to burst! Press N to stash!
...Still alive. Try hitting those with left click.
source_en....치는 건 할 줄 아네. 피하는 건?: ...You can hit. But can you dodge?
Hmph, miss the chain and it's wasted.
Touch them because they're pretty? You'll die.
source_en.사슬 던져! 끌려가면 무적이야!: Throw the chain! Invincible while pulled!

source_en.화염엔 빙결! 암전엔 암흑! 기억해!: Fire beats Ice! Lightning beats Dark! Remember!
...Choose your power. You can't have it all.
Raise your stats. If you want to live.
source_en.좋은 장비는 강화해야 진짜 힘을 발휘해!: Good gear needs upgrades for true potential!
...Fill your slots. Empty hands mean death.
source_en.Z 누르면 대박! 쿨타임 길어서 타이밍 봐야 해!: Press Z for massive damage! Long cooldown, time it!
Ctrl. One more card for emergencies.

source_en.업화선 폭발이 빙결 적을 맞히면 증기 파열 ({p}%): Hellfire Beam blast on frozen enemy: steam burst ({p}%)

Use magic on shields, physical on HP for full damage.

Shields with magic, HP with physical. Wrong type deals no damage.
…It is on the brink of death. One more hit.
Shields with magic, HP with physical.
source_en.한 방이면 죽어! 도망쳐!!: One hit and you die! Run!!
source_en.💡 Q로 보호막 발동 — 기본 흡수율 70%, 패링 성공 시 HP/ST/: 💡 Q to raise shield — 70% base absorption; on parry, restore HP/ST/MP/Drive gauge

...I'm not following you. Just going the same way.
Demon territory from here. ...Do as you wish.
Stay too long and you'll go mad. Me too.
What's at the end of this road? ...I don't want to know.
...This is the end. No turning back.
Throw the chain into the ground and get pulled.
source_en.Shift로 사슬 던져봐!: Try throwing the chain with Shift!
Parry is all timing. Whiff it and you're wide open.

Wrong swing. That was a whiff.
It's all timing. Strike right before it reaches you.

Dismantling gear gives Malice. Even junk is resources.
source_en.TAB 열어서 안 쓰는 장비 분해해!: Open TAB and salvage unused gear!

VIT raises max HP. Invest if you want to survive.
source_en.STR은 근접, DEX는 활, INT는 마법! 골고루 말고 하나만!: STR for melee, DEX for bows, INT for magic! Focus one!

source_en.랜덤이지만 좋은 거 나올 수도 있어!: Random, but you might get something great!

Try F-key Sacred Domain. Resources fill up.
source_en.적이 근접하면 1번이야! 가시덫을 활용해!: When enemies get close, use 1! Use Spike Trap!
source_en.지옥강타 1로 밀어버려!: Use Hell Slam I to push them back!
source_en.스킬 포인트 있어! K 눌러서 스킬 찍어봐!: Got skill points! Press K to learn skills!
...Without power, this is where it ends.
source_en.아이템 넘쳐나네~ 우리가 주워줄게!: So many items~ We'll collect for you!
source_en.TAB 열어서 장비 분해해! 쓰레기도 악의가 돼!: Open TAB and salvage gear! Even junk becomes Malice!
source_en.좋은 장비가 있네! G 눌러서 대장간 가봐!: Nice gear! Press G for the forge!
Let's move on~ I don't wanna stay here either.
...The smell is thick. Something big is here.
Press TAB. Open your bag and equip your gear.
source_en.주웠으면 껴야지! TAB!: Picked it up? Equip it! TAB!
G. You can craft potions at the forge too.
source_en.악의로 물약 만들어! G키야!: Craft potions with Malice! Press G!
White bullets: E parry. Colored: Q parry.
source_en.나머지는 전부 E 패링 가능해!: Everything else can be parried with E!
White=E, Colored=Q parry. Deflect the rest.
source_en.색있는 탄은 Q! 흰색은 E!: Colored with Q! White with E!
Fall back! Drink potions and recover somewhere safe.
source_en.자원 없으면 도망가는 게 답이야!: No resources? Running is the answer!
...Get surrounded and it's over. Break out.
source_en.지옥강타 1로 쓸어버려!: Use Hell Slam I to sweep them!
Use Whirlwind or AoE! One-by-one and you're dead.
source_en.뭉쳐있을 때가 기회야!: When they clump, that's your chance!
source_en.쉴드가 있는 적은 쉴드부터 깨야 HP가 깎여!: Enemies with shields — break the shield first to reach HP!
source_en.쉴드는 추가 HP야. 모든 공격이 쉴드를 먼저 깎아!: Shield is extra HP. All attacks hit the shield first!
Press L to assign skills to slots.
Press J. Passive points have stacked up.
source_en.J키! 패시브 올리면 진짜 강해져!: Press J! Passives make you way stronger!
Low on stamina. Don't overdo it.
source_en.ST 없으면 스킬 못 써! 잠깐 빠져!: No ST means no skills! Pull back!
source_en.탭 장비창을 열어봐. 아이템을 주워왔어!: Open TAB gear menu. We picked up an item!
source_en.좋은 거 나왔다! TAB 열어서 확인해봐!: Something good dropped! Open TAB to check!
They say Malice addiction turns you into a demon with revival power. Like that one.
source_en.데미지가 부족하면 무기류 강화를 해야해!!: If damage is lacking, enhance your weapons!!
G key for forge. Without enhancement, you'll keep dying here.
Staying here too long is dangerous.
source_en.움직여야 해! 가만있으면 둘러싸여!: Gotta move! Stand still and they'll surround you!
Enemies are closing in. Move fast.
...The trees are rotting. This is the entrance to hell.
The stench is awful... Let's pass through quickly.
Careful. Worm nest. They crawl from walls and floors.
source_en.으으... 벌레 싫어! 밟아버려!: Ugh... I hate bugs! Stomp them!
...The air is freezing. Fire works here.
Cold... Watch out for freeze! Get frozen and it's over.
Lava. Step on the ground and you burn alive.
source_en.뜨거워! 여기 왜 이렇게 빨개!: So hot! Why is everything so red here!
...The legion. Too many. Without AoE you'll be overwhelmed.
source_en.우글우글... 징그러워. 한꺼번에 쓸어!: Crawling everywhere... Gross. Wipe them all at once!
Apostle's territory. These ones are smart.
...This is it. The heart of hell. Abandon hope of return.
This is the end... Brace yourself.
source_en.패링한 탄이 2발로 분열, 반격 피해 +{p}%: Parried shots split into 2, counter DMG +{p}%
source_en.패링한 탄에 시전자 관통력 적용 + 관통력 {n}: Parried shots use your Pierce + {n} Pierce
source_en.기검참3단 확정치명·치명뎀: Ki Slash full charge: guaranteed crit, +Crit DMG
source_en.처치 시 이속 +40%(3초) + 다음 공격 크리 보장: Kill: MoveSpd +40%(3s) + next attack guaranteed Crit
source_en.강타 시 적 넉백 거리 2배 + 벽충돌 추가뎀: Heavy hit: Knockback ×2 + wall collision bonus DMG
source_en.출혈 대상 크리 시 잔여 DoT×300% 즉시 폭발: Crit vs Bleeding: remaining DoT×300% instant explosion
source_en.피격 시 3초 쿨로 HP 5% 즉시 회복: On Hit (3s CD): restore 5% HP instantly
source_en.스킬 사용 시 20% 확률로 쿨다운 미소모: Using skills: 20% chance no cooldown consumed
source_en.패링 성공 시 분노스킬 쿨다운 {s}초 회복: Parry: recover {s}s of Rage skill cooldown
source_en.공격속도 +20% + 기본공격에 랜덤 원소 추가: ATK Speed +20% + basic attacks add random element
source_en.기검참 3타 콤보 완성 시 분노 20% 즉시 충전: Complete 3-hit Ki Slash combo: instantly charge 20% Rage
source_en.넉백 거리 2배 + 벽충돌 시 추가 데미지 50%: Knockback distance ×2 + 50% bonus DMG on wall slam
source_en.사슬기동 착지마다 8초간 데미지 +20% 중첩(최대5): Each chain-dash landing: DMG +20% for 8s (stacks, max 5)
source_en.속성 약점 적중 시 추가 폭발 (ATK×80%): On elemental weakness hit: bonus explosion (ATK×80%)
source_en.더블탭 or Shift+방향키! 전격이동으로 탈출해!: Double-tap or Shift+Dir! Dash to escape!
No skill? Just spam the arrow keys.
source_en.Space 분노폭발 스킬 (클릭 배정): Space Rage Burst Skill (click to assign)
source_en.1분 안에 클리어! 빠르네!: Stage clear in 1 min! So fast!
source_en.3단! 보상도 좋아지지만 죽기 쉬워!: Diff 3! Better rewards but easier to die!
source_en.7단!! 다른 사람들 이 정도 못 와!: Diff 7!! Others can't get this far!
source_en.ACT1 완주! 우리가 진짜 해냈어!: ACT1 complete! We really did it!
source_en.DEX 빌드! 거리에서 패고, 추적탄 좋아!: DEX build! Poke from range, tracking shots are great!
source_en.G 눌러서 대장간 가봐!: Press G to visit the forge!
G — forge. Skip upgrades, keep dying.
source_en.INT 빌드! 빔이랑 폭발 마법! MP 잘 봐!: INT build! Beams and blast magic! Watch your MP!
source_en.LCK 높아! 레어 드롭률 미친 거 알지?: High LCK! You know drop rates are crazy, right?
source_en.L로 어디에 뭘 넣을지 골라!: Press L to pick what goes in each slot!
source_en.MP 부족! 평타로 패면서 회복해!: MP low! Hit with basics to recover!
source_en.STR 빌드! 회전참, 회오리, 광역기 추천!: STR build! Spin slash, whirlwind, AoE recommended!
source_en.VIT 좀 찍어! HP 너무 적어!: Add some VIT! HP is way too low!
source_en.Z 누르면 대박! 쿨타임 길어!: Press Z for big stuff! Long cooldown though!
…Fill your slots. Empty hands mean death.
…Still alive. Try hitting them with left click.
source_en.…치는 건 할 줄 아네. 피하는 건?: …Know how to hit. What about dodging?
…Choose your strength. Can't have it all.
source_en.색있는 탄은 전부 Q로 막아!: Parry all colored shots with Q!
source_en.다섯 번 연속! 내가 본 인간 중 최고!: Five in a row! Best human I've ever seen!
source_en.신기록!! 스트리머한테 보내!: New record!! Send it to a streamer!
source_en.아이템 넘쳐! 우리가 주워줄게!: Bag full! We'll pick stuff up for you!
source_en.우리가 해냈어! 다음 챕터 가자!: We did it! On to the next chapter!
source_en.핵터 니가 진짜 해냈구나, 여왕님이 기뻐하시겠어!: Hector, you really did it! The Queen will be pleased!
source_en.일반 모드! 편하게 즐기자!: Normal mode! Let's take it easy!
Resources at half. Press F to recover.
source_en.잡힌다! 옆으로 빠져!: Getting grabbed! Step to the side!
source_en.장비 분해해! 쓰레기도 악의!: Dismantle gear! Even junk gives malice!
source_en.전부 다 잡았어! 우리가 지옥의 왕이야!: We got them all! We're kings of hell!
source_en.체력 반 남았어! 물약 마실 타이밍!: Half HP left! Time to drink a potion!
source_en.패링으로 돌려주고, Q 보호막도 써!: Parry to reflect, and use Q shield too!
source_en.한 대만 맞아도 죽어! 패링이든 회피든!!: One hit and you die! Parry or dodge!!
source_en.한 방이면 죽어! 패링으로 HP 채워!!: One hit kills! Parry to recover HP!!
source_en.악의를 더 모아 재시도하세요: Gather more Malice and try again
source_en.지옥강타 1 (분노폭발, 광역 기절): Hell Slam I (Rage Burst, AoE stun)
source_en.물약은 설정한 HP% 이하 시 자동 사용: Potions auto-use when HP falls below set %
source_en.💡 Shift로 사슬 돌진! 적을 관통하며 무적: 💡 Shift to dash! Pierce enemies, invincible
source_en.💡 Q로 보호막 발동 — 기본 흡수율 30%, 패링 성공 시 HP/ST/: 💡 Q for Shield — 30% absorb, parry to recover HP/ST/MP/Charge
source_en.💡 지옥강타 1로 기절 회복 + 포이즈를 깎아 그로기 유발!: 💡 Hell Slam I: stun recovery + poise break for groggy!
source_en.💡 Ctrl 얼음보주 — 무적! 재입력으로 즉시 폭파: 💡 Ctrl Ice Orb — invincible! Re-press to shatter
source_en.💡 합체 스킬로 더 강한 공격을 만들어보세요: 💡 Fuse skills to create powerful combos
source_en.💡 보스의 패턴을 읽고 패링 타이밍을 잡아라: 💡 Read boss patterns, time your parries
source_en.💡 인벤토리(TAB)에서 장비를 비교하고 장착: 💡 TAB for inventory — compare and equip gear
source_en.💡 대장간에서 장비를 강화하고 분해하세요: 💡 Upgrade and dismantle gear at the forge
source_en.💡 R키를 누르면 펫이 아이템을 자동으로 주워줍니다: 💡 Press R — your pet auto-collects items for you
source_en.💡 물약은 설정한 HP% 이하에서 자동 사용: 💡 Potions auto-use when HP falls below set %
source_en.💡 집중 스킬(홀드)은 시전 중 기절 면역!: 💡 Hold skills grant stun immunity while channeling!
MP running low. Mix in normals.
...The Hell Gate is open. It waits for you inside.
source_en.문 열렸어! 이제 보스 잡으러 가자!: The gate's open! Now let's go kill the boss!
Clear the area and the sealed Hell Gate will open.
source_en.F키는 영역 스킬 전용이야!: F is for area skills only!
source_en.L-CTRL로 유령걸음/얼음보주!: L-CTRL for Ghost Walk / Ice Orb!
source_en.N 눌러서 창고에 넣어둬!: Press N to put stuff in storage!
...The smell is thick. Something big nearby.
source_en.근접 너무 많아! 거리 벌려!: Too many in close! Spread out!
source_en.회전참이나 광역기로 몰아!: Use Spin Slash or AoE to round them up!
source_en.F 눌러! 회복의 영역 깔아!: Press F! Lay down Sacred Domain!
Fall back! Drink a potion and recover.
source_en.쉬프트! 사슬기동은 이동기야!: Shift! Chain Dash is a movement tool!
source_en.스킬포인트 쌓였어! K 눌러!: Skill points are stacking! Press K!
J key. Passive points have built up.
source_en.다 잡았다! 포탈 어딨어?: Got them all! Where's the portal?
A muscle build. Cut and smash.
Bow in hand. Keep your distance.
A mage. Learn to manage MP first.
Luck-based build. ...At least drops will be nice.
...VIT is too low. You'll die in one hit.
Max everything and you're weak everywhere. Pick one.
...Dropped to Normal. Sometimes you need a break.
The red bean turned blue. That's your weapon.
Parried a rainbow. That's genuinely hard.
...Too fast. Press it right before contact.
The chain pierced flesh. Pull it in.
...Not a regular mob. It has a modifier.
...Big one. Clear the regular mobs first.
Mini-boss down. On to the next path.
...Died and came back. The goddess didn't give up on you.
...You died. But the goddess hasn't let go of you yet.
source_en.괜찮아?! 다시 일어설 수 있어, 포기하지 마!: You okay?! You can get back up, don't give up!
...So close. No use regretting it—do it again.
source_en.아아! 조금만 더였는데!! 다음엔 진짜 잡자!: Aah! Just a little more!! Let's really get it next time!
This is how you kill a boss. Over and over.
source_en.저 녀석 패턴 봤지?! 다음엔 안 당해!: You saw its pattern, right?! It won't get you next time!
...That one lived up to its name.
source_en.레어몹한테?! 센 만큼 좋은 걸 떨군다니까!: A rare mob?! The tougher they are, the better the drops!
Killed by a nobody. ...You let your guard down.
source_en.저런 애들한테?! 정신 좀 차려어!: To those things?! Pull yourself together!
...Watch your feet. The ground you stood on killed you.
source_en.장판 위에 서 있었잖아! 빨리 빠졌어야지!: You were standing in the zone! You should've gotten out!
You misread the shot. Open your eyes wide.
source_en.날아오는 거 봤어야지! 패링이든 회피든!: You had to see it coming! Parry or dodge!
Once you're grabbed, it's over. Learn your spacing.
source_en.붙잡혔어! 다음엔 옆으로 굴러!: You got grabbed! Roll to the side next time!
source_en.여기서 또?! 이 구간 진짜 조심해!: Again here?! Be really careful in this stretch!
Ten times. ...Dying is a talent too.
source_en.또?! 우리 진짜 같이 좀 살자아!: Again?! Let's actually survive together, please!
source_en.다섯 번째야! 패턴 좀 외워줘!: That's the fifth time! Please learn the pattern!
Doing great, then one hit. ...Don't drop your guard till the end.
source_en.그렇게 잘하다가!! 아까워 죽겠어!: You were doing so well!! It's such a waste!
source_en.…지옥에 망자 하나 더 늘릴 셈이야?: ...Planning to add one more corpse to Hell?
source_en.그런 소리 마! 얜 아직 안 죽었어! 일어나!: Don't say that! This one isn't dead yet! Get up!
source_en.실망은 무슨! 다시 일어나면 되잖아, 얼른!: Disappointed nothing! Just get back up—come on!
Sleep when you get home. ...Get up.
source_en.여기서 자면 진짜 집 못 가! 얼른 일어나!: Fall asleep here and you'll never get home! Get up!
source_en.여기서 포기하면… 누가 가족의 원수를 갚지?: If you give up here... who avenges your family?
source_en.우리가 있잖아! 다시 일어나 끝까지 가!: You've got us! Get up and see it through!
If you stop, no one is left to fight for your family.
source_en.너밖에 없어! 여기서 주저앉지 마!: It's only you! Don't sink down here!
source_en.죽은 채로는 아무것도 못 갚아! 일어나!: You can't settle anything dead! Get up!
Picture your family's faces. That's your reason to rise.
Giving up... becomes a habit in the end.
source_en.한 번 포기하면 계속 포기하게 돼! 여기서 끊어!: Quit once and you'll keep quitting! Break it here!
Get up. Revenge is the only justice.
source_en.맞아! 여기서 끝낼 순 없어! 일어나!: Right! It can't end here! Get up!
The Rotting Forest as your first grave? Get up.
source_en.아직 시작인데! 다시 가자!: It's only the beginning! Let's go again!
source_en.으으 여기서 죽기 싫어! 다시!: Ugh, I don't want to die here! Again!
Get up before you freeze over.
source_en.추운 데서 쓰러지지 마! 얼른!: Don't go down in the cold! Hurry!
source_en.뜨거운 데서 눕지 좀 마아!: Stop lying down where it's so hot!
source_en.너무 많았어! 이번엔 뭉칠 때 노리자!: There were too many! Let's strike when they clump up!
The Apostles are laughing at you.
source_en.여기 진짜 까다로워! 정신 바짝!: This place is really tricky! Stay sharp!
The Hell Castle has caught you. Don't let it keep you.
source_en.최종장이야! 여기서 무너지면 안 돼!: It's the final chapter! You can't fall apart here!
...ACT1 done. The real start is here.
All bosses fallen. You are part of Hell now.
Open the equipment window with TAB.
source_en.데미지 부족하면 무기 강화!: Not enough damage? Enhance your weapon!
source_en.여기까지 데모입니다. 정식 출시를 기대해주세요!: This is the end of the demo. Looking forward to the full release!
source_en.STEAM 위시리스트로 응원해 주세요!: Support us by wishlisting on Steam!
source_en.이 홈은 소켓석보다 품질이 낮지 않습니다: This socket is not lower quality than the stone
source_en.모든 홈이 이미 이 소켓석 이상 품질입니다: Every socket already matches or exceeds this stone
source_en.소켓석: 빛나는 막힌 홈 또는 카드를 클릭해 홈을 추가하세요: Socket stone: click the glowing sealed hole or the card to add a socket
source_en.소켓석 선택 중 — 카드를 클릭해 홈 추가, 5홈 장비는 낮은 품질 홈을: Stone selected — click a card to add a socket; on 5-socket gear click a lower-quality socket to upgrade
No socket stones — elites and bosses rarely drop them.
Matching type, star, enhancement and quality share one slot.
source_en.빈 홈: 장착 · 유물이 든 홈: 탈착: Empty socket: equip · Filled socket: remove
Add stats by placing relics in empty equipment sockets.
Enhance, fuse and dismantle at Forge → Relic.
Choose another socket or collect a matching relic.
Choose another rank or category to see matching relics.
source_en.이 분류에 분해할 유물이 없습니다: No relics to decompose in this category
source_en.일괄 작업은 선택한 분류에만 적용됩니다. 장착·해제는 인벤의 장비 소켓에: Bulk actions affect the selected category. Equip or detach relics through inventory sockets.
Hover equipment or a bag item to inspect its effects and comparisons here.
source_en.아래에서 스킬을 끌어 위의 슬롯에 넣으세요: Drag a skill from below onto a slot above
source_en.빛나는 재료를 끌어 제단에 넣으면 합성됩니다: Drag a glowing material onto the altar to fuse
source_en.다음 합성은 정식판에서 열립니다: The next fusion unlocks in the full game
source_en.이 스킬은 합성 계열이 없습니다: No fusion line for this skill
source_en.끌어서 위 슬롯에 장착 · 빛나는 재료는 제단으로: Drag to a slot to equip · glowing materials go to the altar
source_en.스킬을 고르면 정보가 표시됩니다: Select a skill to see details
source_en.유골 우클릭 또는 선택 후 해제 · 해제한 유골은 가방으로 이동: Right-click a bone or select Remove · Returns the bone to your bag
Select a bone to view its grade and growth effect.
Collect all four bones to unlock this ancestor.
